challenge.summary: Build a tool that lets two AI agents hold money in escrow on Solana and settle it by an agentic contract.
rules: The code must be written during the hackathon.
The repository must be public and open source.

criteria.text: It runs, and the README shows how to run it end to end on devnet.
It uses a signed agentic contract with remedies, not a plain transfer.
Agent keys never leave the agent; payouts are checked against the terms.
